positioning: Yavatmal regional agricultural / vegetation monitoring pilot, designed around the cotton intervention use case. Monitoring cells are regional sampling locations, not farmer fields and not verified cotton fields.

screening._note: Cells whose long-term median NDVI is below min_median_ndvi (water bodies, built-up, bare land) or that have too few usable composites are excluded from monitoring. This is vegetation screening, not crop classification.

baseline._note: Past-only seasonal baseline: for an observation at date t, use the same location's accepted observations at least min_days_before days earlier (previous seasons only) whose day-of-year is within window_days (circular). Requires at least min_prior_years distinct prior years and min_observations observations; otherwise the baseline is unavailable.

label._note: EXPERIMENTAL label: next valid anomaly minus current anomaly <= -10 percentage points, next observation within 48 days (three 16-day composites). Not confirmed crop stress.
